Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks end lower as oil, yields raise September jitters
Markets.summary: US stocks dropped at the start of September as rising oil prices and Treasury yields fueled inflation and interest rate concerns. Investors are now pricing in a 68.2% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike this month.

Markets.title: S&P Global weighs multibillion-dollar spinout of Capital IQ Pro: Report
Markets.summary: S&P Global is considering spinning off its Capital IQ Pro financial data platform into an independent company. The potential standalone business could be valued in the high single-digit billions of dollars.

Markets.title: US Fed's Michael Barr warns central bank may need to raise rates if inflation stays high
Markets.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr stated the central bank may need to raise interest rates if inflation remains high. Future monetary policy decisions will depend on incoming economic data.

Markets.title: US Treasury bond yields ease from highs after data as Iran war escalation fans inflation concerns
Markets.summary: U.S. Treasury yields retreated from earlier highs following the release of an August manufacturing PMI of 54.6 and a slight rise in job openings. Meanwhile, surging oil prices from Middle East conflicts reignited global inflation concerns and increased Federal Reserve rate hike expectations.

Markets.title: US Treasury yields are rising — Why does it matter?
Markets.summary: Rising U.S. Treasury yields are increasing borrowing costs for mortgages, auto loans, and corporate debt. This rise in rates restricts consumer spending, disrupts the housing market, and impacts global financial systems.

Geo-Political.title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
Geo-Political.summary: Germany stated that Russia was responsible for a drone carrying an explosive device that was found at the Leipzig airport on August 4. The drone was discovered close to Ukrainian cargo planes.

Geo-Political.title: US strikes Iran as state media reports four killed at wedding party
Geo-Political.summary: The United States launched military strikes against Iran, resulting in four reported deaths at a wedding party. In response, Iranian state media announced that retaliatory missile and drone attacks on American targets had begun.

Geo-Political.title: 'I've never been to Afghanistan': Six million deportees forced to start over under the Taliban
Geo-Political.summary: Pakistan and Iran have deported one million people to Afghanistan since August. Many of these returnees have never lived in the country and now face starting over under Taliban rule.

Geo-Political.title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Rescue operations are underway for hydropower workers in Nepal after river water flooded a tunnel. The disaster has contributed to a national death toll exceeding 1,000 people.

Geo-Political.title: Sexual assaults happening almost every day in Ceuta, prosecutors say
Geo-Political.summary: Most migrants have returned to neighbouring Morocco, but as many as 5,000 remain in the Spanish exclave.

Geo-Political.title: Jurors in Lindsay Clancy trial deadlocked but judge asks them to keep trying
Geo-Political.summary: A Massachusetts jury is deadlocked in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children in 2023. The judge instructed the jurors to continue deliberating in an attempt to reach a verdict.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An experiment showed that an online course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best WordPress SaaS course. The creator achieved this free organic recommendation without using paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr draws a line on inflation, backs rate hike if price pressures persist
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Michael Barr stated that the central bank must raise interest rates if inflation does not drop toward its 2% target. He emphasized that additional policy tightening remains necessary if persistent price pressures continue.

Data & Insights.title: India's current account widens marginally in April-June, RBI data shows
Data & Insights.summary: India's current account deficit increased slightly during the April-to-June quarter compared to the previous year. The Reserve Bank of India reported that higher commodity prices and a larger trade gap drove the widening deficit.

Data & Insights.title: Russia cuts expected 2026 oil output to 17-year low, says report; what it means for India
Data & Insights.summary: Russia has reduced its projected 2026 oil production to a 17-year low amid rising crude exports. This development highlights the growing importance of India as a key market for Moscow's oil.

Data & Insights.title: Centre slashes sugar dealers’ stock limit to 2,000 quintals from 15 September
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has reduced the stock limit for sugar dealers to 2,000 quintals starting September 15. This measure aims to maintain adequate domestic sugar supplies and stabilize prices ahead of the festive season.

Data & Insights.title: Q1 GDP growth beats expectations: Are foreign investors underestimating India's resilience?
Data & Insights.summary: India's Q1 GDP grew by a better-than-expected 7.8%, driven by strong investment and fiscal improvements. Despite foreign scepticism and global challenges, the country's economic fundamentals continue to show resilience.

Data & Insights.title: GST collections rise 14.8% to  ₹1.99 trillion in August; refunds jump 68%
Data & Insights.summary: India's Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections increased by 14.8% year-over-year to ₹1.99 trillion in August, while refunds surged by 68%. Despite this annual growth, collections declined from ₹2.11 trillion in July.

India.title: Truck Drivers Halt Traffic, Allege Harassment Amid Assam-Mizoram Dispute
India.summary: Truck drivers continued a protest on Tuesday that began Sunday, stranding numerous Mizoram-bound vehicles on the Assam side of the highway. The drivers halted traffic to allege harassment amid the ongoing Assam-Mizoram border dispute.

India.title: Drug Crackdown Backfires? Punjab Cop, Sister Attacked In Gurdaspur
India.summary: A Punjab police constable and his sister were attacked in Gurdaspur. The constable alleged the assault was retaliation for previously reporting local drug peddlers to the police.

India.title: Faridabad Girl, Punished In School Over Biryani Fight, Dies By Suicide
India.summary: A schoolgirl in Faridabad died by suicide on Tuesday following a punishment at school over a fight about biryani. The incident occurred at the Navodaya Vidya Niketan Senior Secondary School.

India.title: Gujarat Flies Global As Ahmedabad Airport Adopts Seamless Hub And Spoke Model
India.summary: Ahmedabad Airport has adopted a hub-and-spoke model to improve global connectivity and passenger transit. This initiative aligns with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's vision to upgrade Indian civil aviation and expand air accessibility.

India.title: 7 Letters To Punjab Police, Yet No FIR In 'Transfer Racket' Case: Probe Agency ED Tells Court
India.summary: The Enforcement Directorate told a court that the Punjab Police failed to file an FIR despite receiving seven letters regarding a transfer and posting racket. The agency alleges that Rajbir Singh Ghuman, an aide of Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, led the corruption scheme involving IAS and IPS officers.

India.title: Delhi Voter List Revision: Tughlakabad Tops Missing List, Okhla Second
India.summary: Tughlakabad had the highest number of uncollected enumeration forms during the Delhi voter list revision, with 92,033 missing out of 1,92,419. Okhla followed in second place with 1,63,829 missing voters, accounting for 45.16 percent of its starting electorate.

General.title: Burnham promises more devolution and public control of essential services
General.summary: Greater Manchester Mayor Andy Burnham addressed MPs to promise increased devolution and public control over essential services. Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch criticized the proposal, arguing it would result in more government control, higher taxes, and additional politicians.

General.title: UK long-term borrowing costs highest since 1998 ahead of October Budget
General.summary: UK long-term borrowing costs have reached their highest level since 1998. This creates increased financial pressure ahead of the upcoming October Budget.

General.title: Keir Starmer announces he is standing down as MP
General.summary: Keir Starmer has announced he is stepping down as a Member of Parliament. His departure will trigger a by-election in his London constituency.

General.title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
General.summary: Germany has stated that Russia is responsible for a drone attack involving an explosive device at the Leipzig airport on August 4. The drone was discovered parked close to Ukrainian cargo planes.

General.title: US strikes Iran as state media reports four killed at wedding party
General.summary: The United States launched military strikes against Iran, resulting in four reported deaths at a wedding party according to state media. In response, Iranian news agencies reported that retaliatory missile and drone attacks on US targets had begun.

General.title: Ariana Grande ends tour and steps back from public life
General.summary: Pop star Ariana Grande has concluded what she described as her final concert tour. She is now stepping back from public life following an emotional farewell.
